resultmsu.sentence: The circular polymerase extension reaction (CPER) has emerged as a high-fidelity, versatile, and rapid tool for generating infectious cDNA clones of positive-sense, single-stranded RNA viruses.
This strategy was implemented to generate infectious cDNA clones of two closely related members of the family.
